title: 秋華賞の後に・トリプルティアラ達成

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon dominates the Shuka Sho and successfully claims the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives me a shout-out at the post-race press conference, citing me as her trusty partner and the reason behind her progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She goes on to challenge Narita Brian to a one-on-one at the upcoming Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian watches the broadcast in real time and laughs to herself, impressed—but not intimidated.
